kind.description: agent: builds its owned paths from fausto tasks. human: a person, such as the orchestrator. auditor: reviews pull requests against the spec and owns nothing.

owns.description: Files, or directories ending in /. The most specific entry across all agents owns a file. Required, and not empty, except for an auditor, which owns nothing.

reviewers.description: GitHub users (@name) or teams (@org/team) who review changes to the owned paths; fausto writes them to .github/CODEOWNERS. Without any, a charter's paths go to the reviewers of every human charter.
